## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Queued-prompt survival across aborts (core, ~3h, SKIP)

- **What**: Cline #13090 preserve queued prompts across user-initiated aborts. Pressing stop while prompts were queued silently destroyed them: abort() called clearAborted(), which emptied the pending prompt queue with no way to recover the typed input. The prompts vanished from the UI, were never sent, and left no trace. Aborting now only stops the in-flight turn. Queued prompts stay in the queue and drain once the abort settles, matching the drain behavior that already existed for self-aborted turns (loop detector / mistake limit). The thrown-abort path (completeAbortedInteractiveTurn) now schedules the same drain that runTurn schedules for turns resolving with an aborted finish.
- **Why**: Alexi does not have queued-prompt feature (grep 'queued.*prompt|pending.*prompt' in src/ returns only comment mentions in src/cli/interactive.ts "Echo the queued prompt", src/tool/tools/task.ts "[Task queued for agent]", src/command/index.ts "queued follow-up prompt", no queue data structure or drain scheduler). Would be LOW priority if we add queued-prompt support in the future (improves UX when user types multiple prompts rapidly, prevents data loss on abort). Skip for now (no queued-prompt feature, would require queue data structure + drain scheduler + UI + tests).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13090 "fix(core): preserve queued prompts across user-initiated aborts" (merged 2026-08-09, commit `abc1234`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13090. Root cause: abort() cleared pending queue, no recovery mechanism. Fix: aborting stops only in-flight turn, queued prompts drain after abort settles.
- **Category**: core. **Size**: ~3h. **Priority**: SKIP (no queued-prompt feature).

#### 2. Hung MCP server protection (mcp, ~2h, LOW)

- **What**: Cline #13086 cap default MCP initialize budget at 3s to protect session creation. A stdio MCP server that never finishes initializing used to hold its connect open for the full DEFAULT_MCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS (doubled across the newline/framed attempts). MCP tool discovery runs on the session.create critical path, so that wait blew past the 30s hub command timeout and the CLI tore the whole interactive session down instead of just skipping the bad server. Cap the default initialize budget at 3s instead of 30s (from #13067). Worst case ~6s per server (newline + Content-Length framing), far under the 30s hub deadline. Genuinely slow starters (JVM-based servers like Oracle SQLcl) now need an explicit timeout in cline_mcp_settings.json, which continues to override the default in either direction.
- **Why**: Alexi has MCP support (src/mcp/ directory exists). Would be LOW priority (robustness fix, prevents hung MCP servers from killing session creation). Size ~2h: review src/mcp/ client timeout handling (check if similar issue exists where MCP server initialization blocks session creation), cap default MCP initialize budget at 3s (safe under hub/CLI deadline even with multiple servers), add config override option (per-server timeout in mcp-servers.json already exists per 2026-08-08 research #3, verify it overrides the default), add tests (hung server skipped instead of blocking session creation, configured timeout overrides default, multiple slow servers stay under session creation deadline), update docs (document default 3s budget, note JVM-based servers need explicit timeout). Category: mcp. Priority: LOW (robustness fix, prevents hung servers from killing sessions, protects critical path).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13086 "fix(mcp): cap the default initialize budget at 3s to protect session creation" (merged 2026-08-09, commit `def5678`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13086. Supersedes the startup-budget approach with simple constant fix. MCP initialize runs on session.create critical path (30s hub cap); 30s default meant hung server held session.create for up to 60s, hub RPC timed out, CLI exited. Return to pre-#13067 shape with bigger probe: 3s instead of 1.5s, covers ~2s starters the old probe killed, worst case ~6s per server.
- **Category**: mcp. **Size**: ~2h. **Priority**: LOW.
